summary: Adds a new acceptance test file for router watches. It covers every backend type in standalone and middleware modes: event streaming, watch-list bookmarks, timeoutSeconds, client disconnect, half-open breaker release, separate metrics, backend replacement, service stop, and upgrade rejection. It is test-only, so it cannot change production behavior, and a line-by-line review can be skipped.
headline: Add watch acceptance tests across all router backends and modes
reason: New test-only file that cannot affect production behavior; it only adds coverage for the watch changes.
